verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only sharing controls: who may edit, comment on, or open a file, plus writer and commenter permission roles. Those are adjacent access controls, not evidence of real-time, in-browser co-editing of docs, sheets, or slides. One community post names Docs, Sheets and Slides, but only in the context of a content policy, so nothing in the pack shows simultaneous in-place editing.

support.subject: As an operations lead, documents are editable in place — real-time co-editing of docs/sheets/slides in the browser, native or via a documented integration
